https://leafletjs.com/
https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz
The package contains code and UI images only, not map tiles.
OpenStreetMap tiles are requested only after the online-map button is pressed.
Tiles must not be downloaded in bulk, preloaded, or included in the PWA cache.
https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
